description: AOMIC 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：aomic 质控汇总；aomic 表型/刺激提取；aomic 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: aomic 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries and exclusion lists for AOMIC. Combines fMRIPrep confounds and FreeSurfer recon-all metrics to produce a unified QC report with configurable exclusion criteria。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory); freesurfer_dir: Path to FreeSurfer output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: aomic 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge AOMIC phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads AOMIC phenotype files (Big Five personality, Raven's progressive matrices, demographics), selects columns, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing AOMIC phenotype CSV/TSV files (directory); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: aomic 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Validate and reorganize AOMIC data into BIDS-style directory structure. AOMIC (Amsterdam Open MRI Collection) data is typically already in BIDS format. This script validates structure, handles edge cases, and normalizes across sub-datasets (ID1000, PIOP1, PIOP2)。 Inputs: input: Path to AOMIC data directory (directory); participants_file: Optional: path to phenotype file for participant metadata (file). Registered outputs: results/. Fixed invocation options: --copy.

selection_rules: 先确认目标产物、允许使用的已有输入与禁止复用的结果；仅在用户允许时复用已有数据，不默认追加上游步骤。
独立操作选择 Method；确需固定组合时选择 Pipeline，并检查每一步输入输出。
软件工具 Skill 用于选择实现，任务 Skill 用于组织需求，不因为同时匹配两类 Skill 重复添加方法。

Treat missing inputs according to the current goal: for explicitly requested steps, ask for binding or discuss alternatives; when asked to produce a target from stated inputs, add only necessary available producers allowed by the user. Never regenerate an explicitly reused result or silently broaden the scientific goal.

Select by scientific output meaning, stage conditions and spatial/data requirements. A directory, generic image or report does not certify a typed derivative. Do not equate tissue classes, anatomical atlas regions and learned clusters. Query the Method contract for exact ports and conditional parameters; use Pipelines only when their actual steps match the request.
name: aomic-skill
applicability: 输入必须符合 AOMIC 对应脚本的数据发布格式和字段约定；通用影像处理请选软件或任务 Skill。
根据目标选择对应 Method 或 Pipeline；每个入口的输入格式、必要参数和产物以其独立契约为准。
limitations: 格式和样本数量满足仅是必要条件；空间、单位、样本标识与方法假设仍须按所选方法检查。
这里只统筹已登记入口；目录收录不代表覆盖软件全部命令或参数。
环境探测与运行证据分别显示；合成数据测试不代表真实数据的科学有效性。
尚无 Method 的规划能力只能提供说明，不能当作可执行步骤。
